description: Configuration for discobox-server. Every setting may also be set by the environment variable named in its description, which takes precedence over this file (ADR 0096).

archiveRetention.description: How long an archived sandbox is kept before purging, for projects with no retention of their own. Environment: DISCOBOX_ARCHIVE_RETENTION (takes precedence over this file).

cacheDir.description: Reproducible data that may be deleted. Defaults to <XDG cache home>/discobox. Environment: DISCOBOX_CACHE_DIR (takes precedence over this file).

configDir.description: Operator-edited configuration. Defaults to <XDG config home>/discobox. It cannot relocate the configuration file itself, which is found from the environment (ADR 0096 §1). Environment: DISCOBOX_CONFIG_DIR (takes precedence over this file).

dataDir.description: Durable server state: the database, the SSH host key, the iroh endpoint key, authorized_keys and authorized_ids. Defaults to <XDG data home>/discobox. Environment: DISCOBOX_DATA_DIR (takes precedence over this file).

databaseDriver.description: Database driver. Detected from databaseDsn when unset. Environment: DATABASE_DRIVER (takes precedence over this file).

databaseDsn.description: Database DSN. Defaults to a SQLite file under dataDir. Environment: DATABASE_DSN (takes precedence over this file).

databaseReadDsn.description: Optional separate DSN for reads, for a deployment with a read replica. Environment: DATABASE_READ_DSN (takes precedence over this file).

defaultSandboxImage.description: Image for sandboxes that name no harness. Defaults to the built-in sandbox agent image. Environment: DISCOBOX_DEFAULT_SANDBOX_IMAGE (takes precedence over this file).

defaultSandboxImageDigest.description: Digest identifying the build behind defaultSandboxImage. Those sandboxes report no upgrade when it is unknown. Environment: DISCOBOX_DEFAULT_SANDBOX_IMAGE_DIGEST (takes precedence over this file).

devImageManifest.description: Path to the manifest listing the images devImageSync converges. Required when devImageSync is set. Environment: DISCOBOX_DEV_DOCKER_IMAGE_MANIFEST (takes precedence over this file).

devImageSync.description: Converge locally built images onto each Docker daemon before it hosts a development pool. Environment: DISCOBOX_DEV_DOCKER_IMAGE_SYNC (takes precedence over this file).

dispatcherPollInterval.description: How often the job dispatcher polls for work. Environment: DISPATCHER_POLL_INTERVAL (takes precedence over this file).

dockerPoolImage.description: Pool agent image the Docker provider runs. Defaults to the released image for this build. Environment: DISCOBOX_DOCKER_POOL_IMAGE (takes precedence over this file).

encryptionKey.description: Base64 AES key that seals stored secrets. Secrets are stored unsealed when empty. Environment: DISCOBOX_ENCRYPTION_KEY (takes precedence over this file).

imageRetention.description: How long an unused Discobox image is kept on the host Docker daemon. The configured value is propagated into pool containers, so one setting governs both. Environment: DISCOBOX_IMAGE_RETENTION (takes precedence over this file).

iroh.description: Settings for the iroh transport, which is how a server is reached from another network without a port, a certificate, or a name.

logLevel.description: Log the iroh transport as it binds, accepts and refuses: off (the default), error, warn, info, debug, or trace. It also sets the verbosity of iroh's own tracing, which is written to this server's log. The matching client-side setting is discobox --iroh-log. Environment: DISCOBOX_IROH_LOG (takes precedence over this file).

relayUrls.description: Relay servers to use instead of n0's public ones, which are free and need no configuration but rate-limit traffic, are shared with every other iroh deployment, and carry no uptime guarantee. Running your own means running iroh-relay and listing it here. Clients need the same list (discobox --iroh-relay): an address does not carry the server's relay, so a half-configured pair fails when it tries to connect. Address discovery is separate, still uses n0's public service, and is not configurable yet. Environment: DISCOBOX_IROH_RELAY_URLS (takes precedence over this file).

listen.description: Endpoints to listen on. Local IPC is added when none is named, so the CLI can always reach the server. Environment: DISCOBOX_SERVER_LISTEN (takes precedence over this file).

otelMetricExportInterval.description: How often metrics are exported. The OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL environment variable sets this too, in milliseconds, as the OpenTelemetry specification defines it.

otelMetricsEnabled.description: Export OpenTelemetry metrics over OTLP. The OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=otlp environment variable sets this too.

port.description: TCP port for an http:// listen endpoint that does not name one. Environment: PORT (takes precedence over this file).

sandboxReconcileJobConcurrency.description: How many sandbox reconcile jobs run at once. Environment: SANDBOX_RECONCILE_JOB_CONCURRENCY (takes precedence over this file).

stateDir.description: State that should survive a restart but is not precious. Defaults to <XDG state home>/discobox. Environment: DISCOBOX_STATE_DIR (takes precedence over this file).

wslcCommand.description: The WSL Containers program to look for on a Windows host, as a name on PATH or a full path. Empty looks for the component's own name, wslc. Windows only. Environment: DISCOBOX_WSLC_COMMAND (takes precedence over this file).
